title: acinos graveolens
intro: Acinos graveolens, commonly known as Stachys graveolens or pungent hedge nettle, is a perennial plant in the mint family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Acinos graveolens include its ability to relieve digestive issues, reduce fever, and soothe respiratory problems. The plant's bioactive constituents include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
